direction: Calm, precise enterprise workflow with balanced source cards and a blue action accent

spacing.strategy: Preserve component-specific spacing; no global spacing scale is currently declared

motion.layoutStability: Do not animate dimensions or shift adjacent controls when hints and statuses change

componentRules: Preserve the upload, select, match, rules, review, and results workflow
Keep the two source cards balanced and their messages associated with the correct source
Use semantic color variables and synchronize explicit-dark and system-dark overrides
Every status must reflect real application or data state
Reserve space for conditional hints and changing labels
Keep wide data tables within their own scrolling region
Preserve 44px square icon buttons and readable labeled form controls
Preserve original data for uncertain corrections until the user explicitly chooses a replacement
accessibilityRules: Preserve the skip link, semantic controls, associated labels, and logical keyboard order
Preserve a visible 3px focus outline with a 3px offset derived from the focus token
Communicate warning, error, success, selection, and disabled states without color alone
Verify WCAG text contrast and visible focus in light and dark themes
Verify long content and keyboard navigation at 360px and breakpoint boundaries
Honor reduced motion and prevent unexpected layout shifts
verificationNote: This document records implementation values and preservation requirements; it does not certify current accessibility or browser-test results.
